svg.title: Flight recorder
svg.desc:
Master artwork for every generated icon in this folder. Regenerate the set with the tauri CLI's icon command, pointing it at this file; it reads SVG directly, so no rasteriser is needed.
Note for anyone editing the comments here: XML forbids a double hyphen inside a comment, and the tauri CLI's SVG parser rejects the whole file when it finds one. A shell example containing a bare flag separator is enough to break it, which is why this note is a desc element rather than a comment.
Kept as strokes on a transparent ground, with no glow or drop shadow. The reference this came from had a neon bloom, which turns to mud as soon as the icon is scaled to a 16px favicon or a taskbar button.
The colour is baked in because the generated PNG, ICO and ICNS files cannot inherit anything. The copy inlined in index.html uses currentColor instead, so the in-app mark follows the theme.
